title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons After-Hours Addition for Emergency Requests
content:
An after-hours addition is made to the amount Bridgewell pays on an Optional Coverage Add-Ons work authorization, according to the urgency of the request and the day it was placed:

| Request | Day placed | After-hours addition |
|---|---|---|
| Emergency | Saturday or Sunday | USD 150.00 |
| Emergency | Monday through Friday | USD 75.00 |
| Routine | Any day | None |

The addition is made once the amount Bridgewell pays for the work has been fully determined, and it is not itself limited: no cap reduces it. The urgency and the day are those of the rider service request the authorization is issued on, as the request shows them.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- An emergency request placed on a Sunday, with USD 480.00 determined for the work: the authorization amount is USD 630.00.
- An emergency request placed on a Wednesday, with USD 0.00 determined for the work because no cap room remains: the authorization amount is USD 75.00.
- A routine request placed on a Saturday: no addition.
